decision.text: D1 (the /sorted builder_check): Questions a Haiku builder would need, answered. (a) Only cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py changes, in _spawn. (b) In the argv list, end it after the StandardError line, i.e. drop the trailing ', "--", *cmd' from the literal. (c) Then add the three-line comment and: test_id = os.environ.get("CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID"); if test_id: argv += [f"--setenv=CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID={test_id}", "-p", "CollectMode=inactive-or-failed"]; then argv += ["--", *cmd]. (d) Copy the comment shape from cairn/tools/base/shim.py lines 157-159. (e) The proof is already written and committed; run it. Expect 1 of 4 before and 4 of 4 after.
